_about: The capability list for the blog. Source: the 2026-09-14 capability inventory (docs + live product sweep). Every post about one of these links readers to sign up at vodou.ai and carries custom graphics; scripts/blog/capabilities.py enforces both. Only public (Apache-2.0) paths belong here, never an engine path. 'limits' is what has NOT shipped: the writer is told never to imply otherwise. Edit this file to add, reorder or retire a capability.

capabilities.name: Local memory you own
capabilities.pitch: Your AI memory lives in a local SQLite vault on your own machine, searched by keyword and meaning and weighted by where each fact came from. Nothing leaves until you send it.
capabilities.surface: Console Memory tab; vodou-core mem search
capabilities.limits: Encryption at rest and forget-by-TTL are drafts, not shipped.

infographic.alt: Infographic: your AI memory is a file you own. Import, control and portability in a local Vodou vault.

capabilities.cta: Vodou keeps your AI memory in a vault on your own machine and carries it into the chats and coding tools you already use.

capabilities.name: Memory in browser AI chats (Vodou Bridge)
capabilities.pitch: A Chrome extension that saves your chats on the AI sites you use and puts relevant memory into the next chat with Ctrl+B, so what you told ChatGPT on Monday is there in Claude on Thursday. You see it before you send.
capabilities.surface: The Vodou Bridge Chrome extension; Connect, Browser in the console
capabilities.limits: Chrome only. Auto-attach on send is off by default and set per site.

infographic.alt: Infographic: tell ChatGPT once and Claude already knows. Vodou remembers, acts and notices, kept on your computer.

capabilities.cta: Vodou Bridge carries one memory, kept on your own machine, across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and the other AI chats you use.

capabilities.name: Automatic fact capture
capabilities.pitch: Facts are pulled out of your chats and coding sessions as you work, through a job queue with an honest ledger. Corrections replace stale facts, near-duplicates merge, and names resolve to the same person.
capabilities.surface: Automatic; vodou-core mem extract-status

infographic.alt: Infographic: tell ChatGPT once and Claude already knows. Vodou remembers, acts and notices, kept on your computer.

capabilities.cta: Vodou captures what matters from your AI chats automatically and keeps it on your own machine.

capabilities.name: Memory inside IDE and desktop AI tools
capabilities.pitch: Hooks for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Aider and others put your memory into each prompt, and an MCP server exposes the same vault to any MCP client. Your editor and your browser chats read one memory.
capabilities.surface: Automatic once a host is installed; vodou-core hook
capabilities.limits: Zed and JetBrains hooks are planned, not shipped.

infographic.alt: Infographic: tell ChatGPT once and Claude already knows. Vodou remembers, acts and notices, kept on your computer.

capabilities.cta: Vodou gives Claude Code, Cursor and your browser AI chats one shared memory that stays on your machine.

capabilities.name: Skills with stopping points
capabilities.pitch: Teach a workflow once as a markdown skill and run it by name. The engine will not run past a stopping point until you pick an option, so a skill cannot quietly do the destructive step.
capabilities.surface: Skills tab in the console; vodou-core skill list

infographic.alt: Infographic: same brain, it can also act. Skills, MCP tools, automations and workflows with approvals.

capabilities.cta: Vodou runs your skills and tools with the same local memory, and stops for your approval before anything sends.

capabilities.name: Plain-language routing to tools
capabilities.pitch: Ask for something in a sentence and Vodou maps it to the right skill or MCP tool, runs independent calls in parallel, and holds back when a sentence only describes work instead of asking for it.
capabilities.surface: Chat, ./do, vodou-core intent-signal

infographic.alt: Infographic: same brain, it can also act. Skills, MCP tools, automations and workflows with approvals.

capabilities.cta: Vodou turns a plain sentence into the right tool call, with your memory and your approval in the loop.

capabilities.name: MCP connections and app catalog
capabilities.pitch: Connect any stdio or HTTP MCP server, or one-click OAuth apps from a public catalog. A connection ledger tells a dead connector apart from an idle healthy one.
capabilities.surface: Connect, Apps and MCP servers in the console; vodou-core connections

infographic.alt: Infographic: same brain, it can also act. Skills, MCP tools, automations and workflows with approvals.

capabilities.cta: Vodou connects your MCP tools and apps to one local memory, and tells you honestly which connections are alive.

capabilities.name: Scheduler, heartbeat and automations
capabilities.pitch: A scheduler runs jobs on your own time zone, a heartbeat briefs you from live state, and automations watch a tool and run an action chain when something new shows up. Self-hosted, over MCP.
capabilities.surface: Activity, Scheduled and History in the console; vodou-core schedule
capabilities.limits: Automations poll; there are no inbound webhooks.

infographic.alt: Infographic: same brain, it can also act. Skills, MCP tools, automations and workflows with approvals.

capabilities.cta: Vodou runs your automations on your own schedule and your own machine, with your memory attached.

capabilities.name: Multi-agent Kanban Board
capabilities.pitch: Durable tasks that agents pick up with memory attached, with per-task budgets, approval gates, a planner and channel notifications when work moves.
capabilities.surface: Activity, Board in the console; vodou-core board
capabilities.limits: Two of the seven phase-2 items are still open.
capabilities.cta: Vodou's Board hands durable tasks to agents that carry your memory, with budgets and approval gates you control.

capabilities.name: Memory map (Brain)
capabilities.pitch: A graph of your memory where brightness shows how trusted a source is, with conflicts and source history one click away.
capabilities.surface: Memory, Map tab in the console
capabilities.cta: Vodou shows you your memory as a map, with where every fact came from, on your own machine.

capabilities.name: Messaging channels
capabilities.pitch: The same assistant and memory in Slack, Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, iMessage and Google Chat, with owner and guest tiers so a guest never sees your private memory.
capabilities.surface: Connect, Messaging in the console
capabilities.limits: Signal and Teams adapters exist but are not marked stable. Voice is not shipped.

infographic.alt: Infographic: same brain, it can also act. Skills, MCP tools, automations and workflows with approvals.

capabilities.cta: Vodou puts the same assistant and memory in Slack, Telegram, Discord and WhatsApp, running from your own machine.

capabilities.name: Import, export and vaults
capabilities.pitch: Bring in ChatGPT, Claude, Obsidian and Letta history. Imports rank below what you said yourself, a review queue shows where they disagree, and export packs and scoped vaults let you take or share a subset.
capabilities.surface: Memory, Imports in the console; vodou-core mem import

infographic.alt: Infographic: your AI memory is a file you own. Import, control and portability in a local Vodou vault.

capabilities.cta: Vodou imports your history from other AIs into a vault you own, and lets you take it with you.

capabilities.name: Document Library
capabilities.pitch: PDFs, docs, spreadsheets and slide decks become memory, kept in sync when watched files change, attachable in any chat with @doc:, with conflicts between documents flagged.
capabilities.surface: /library in the console; the extension
capabilities.limits: Some phases are still open; do not claim every document workflow is finished.
capabilities.cta: Vodou turns your documents into memory your AI tools can cite, kept on your own machine.

capabilities.name: People pages and commitments
capabilities.pitch: A page per person already in your memory with a brief before you meet, and promises you make in chat tracked and brought back when they are due.
capabilities.surface: Memory, People in the console; Activity open loops

infographic.alt: Infographic: it notices what you promised. Commitments, people pages and a heartbeat about your day.

capabilities.cta: Vodou remembers the people you work with and the promises you made, and brings them back when they matter.

capabilities.name: Conversation recall and continuity
capabilities.pitch: Search a long thread's past turns and keep its decisions through rolling summaries, on one write and read path, so a Slack turn can be recalled later in Cursor.
capabilities.surface: Automatic; vodou-core summaries
capabilities.cta: Vodou keeps long conversations coherent across every tool you use, with memory that stays on your machine.

capabilities.name: Vodou as an MCP host
capabilities.pitch: Any local MCP client, like Claude Desktop, Cursor or VS Code, can attach to Vodou's memory, skills and tools, each with its own identity, rate limit, kill switch and audit log.
capabilities.surface: Settings, Clients in the console; vodou-core mcp install
capabilities.limits: The remote (non-local) host is not shipped.
capabilities.cta: Vodou lets every MCP client on your machine share one memory, with a separate identity and audit log for each.

capabilities.name: Workflows (graph skills)
capabilities.pitch: Describe multi-step work in a sentence and get a plan first: resolved tools, parallel steps, fresh-context checks and approval before anything sends.
capabilities.surface: /workflow in chat; vodou-core workflow
capabilities.limits: Phase 1 is complete; later phases are open. Do not claim more.

infographic.alt: Infographic: same brain, it can also act. Skills, MCP tools, automations and workflows with approvals.

capabilities.cta: Vodou shows you the plan before a multi-step job runs, and waits for your approval.

capabilities.name: Skill Consoles
capabilities.pitch: An assistant creates a recurring skill with its own chat tab that you refine in conversation and put on a schedule.
capabilities.surface: Workbench tab in the console
capabilities.cta: Vodou lets you build a recurring job in conversation and refine it until it is right.

capabilities.name: Script and background job runner
capabilities.pitch: Registered scripts run in the foreground or background with status, live output and cancel, and the result comes back to the chat that started them.
capabilities.surface: Capabilities, Scripts in the console
capabilities.cta: Vodou runs your scripts as tracked jobs and reports back when they finish.

capabilities.name: Enhanced Thinking
capabilities.pitch: Persistent multi-step reasoning sessions that an agent can add to, analyze and complete across turns.
capabilities.surface: Skills; vodou-core call
capabilities.cta: Vodou gives your agents reasoning sessions that persist across turns, on your own machine.

capabilities.name: Browser and Mac control tools
capabilities.pitch: Agents can read, fill and find on your current browser tab, and drive macOS apps through the accessibility tree, when a job needs a local hand.
capabilities.surface: MCP tools available to chat, skills and the Board

infographic.alt: Infographic: same brain, it can also act. Skills, MCP tools, automations and workflows with approvals.

capabilities.cta: Vodou can act in your browser and your Mac apps when a job needs it, with your approval.

capabilities.name: Proactive loops
capabilities.pitch: Registered background checks watch for broken automations, stale data, extraction trouble and capture gaps, each proven by tests to fire when it should and stay quiet when it should not.
capabilities.surface: vodou-core findings; the console loops view

infographic.alt: Infographic: it notices what you promised. Commitments, people pages and a heartbeat about your day.

capabilities.cta: Vodou notices when something in your setup breaks, and stays quiet when nothing did.

capabilities.name: Vodou Console web app
capabilities.pitch: One local web app for chat, memory, activity, skills, connections and settings, with receipts showing which memories, tools and skills each answer used.
capabilities.surface: localhost:8765
capabilities.cta: Vodou gives you one local desk for your AI memory, tools and automations.

capabilities.name: Local OpenAI-compatible API
capabilities.pitch: Point any OpenAI-compatible app at your own machine and it gets your memory, skills and tools, plus a typed REST API with an OpenAPI spec.
capabilities.surface: POST /v1/chat/completions on the local gateway
capabilities.cta: Vodou gives any OpenAI-compatible app on your machine access to your own memory and tools.

capabilities.name: Vodou CLI
capabilities.pitch: An agentic terminal UI you can run from any directory, with slash commands and your memory, without the web app running.
capabilities.surface: vodou in a terminal
capabilities.cta: Vodou brings your memory and tools into the terminal.

capabilities.name: Projects
capabilities.pitch: Several working directories, each with its own chats, file root and instructions, sharing one memory, with pinning to control what shows up where.
capabilities.surface: Projects in the console
capabilities.cta: Vodou keeps each project's context separate while every project shares one memory.

capabilities.name: Model choice and local models
capabilities.pitch: Pick your provider and model, or run local models through bundled llama.cpp or LM Studio, with hardware-based recommendations, prompt caching and per-turn token ceilings.
capabilities.surface: Settings, LLM and Model in the console
capabilities.limits: The Vodou-Mini open-weight model is not shipped.
capabilities.cta: Vodou works with the model you choose, including local ones, and your memory comes along.

capabilities.name: Managed chat file tools
capabilities.pitch: Read, write, edit and search files from web chat with auto, ask and deny profiles, off by default.
capabilities.surface: Chat, with profiles in Settings
capabilities.cta: Vodou lets chat work on your files with permission profiles you set.

capabilities.name: Lenses
capabilities.pitch: Modules that render rich tool output, like maps, tables and cards, instead of raw JSON.
capabilities.surface: Lenses in the console
capabilities.cta: Vodou renders your tool results as readable cards instead of raw JSON.

capabilities.name: Governance and approvals
capabilities.pitch: Approvals and auto-approve policy, a credential store, a localhost-only gateway with CSRF protection, a capture kill switch and per-site capture grading.
capabilities.surface: vodou-core approvals; Connect, Browser in the console
capabilities.limits: An autonomy master switch and a bash sandbox are drafts, not shipped.
capabilities.cta: Vodou asks before anything sends, spends or leaves your machine.

capabilities.name: Health and self-description
capabilities.pitch: Every chat turn carries a ground-truth block computed live, and status commands grade what is actually running rather than what was configured.
capabilities.surface: System status in the console; vodou-core runtime-status
capabilities.cta: Vodou tells you the truth about what is running, computed live.

capabilities.name: Install and auto-update
capabilities.pitch: A one-line install, prebuilt downloads and an auto-updater.
capabilities.surface: vodou-core update
capabilities.limits: Shipped on macOS. Windows and Linux are partial; Windows auto-update has not been verified in the field.
capabilities.cta: Vodou installs with one line and keeps itself up to date.

capabilities.name: Alternate shells (Vodou One, desktop app)
capabilities.limits: Vodou One is gated; the Electron desktop app is mothballed.

capabilities.name: Cloud, teams and SaaS
capabilities.limits: Drafts only. Never write about this as available.
